description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of a request. Generate a unique value from the client for this parameter. The token can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters in length.

description.zh:
地域ID。可能的值：

- cn-hangzhou：华东1（杭州） 。

- ap-southeast-1：新加坡。
description.en:
The region ID. Possible values:

- cn-hangzhou: China (Hangzhou).

- ap-southeast-1: Singapore.
The ID of the service instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenest deploy-service-instance --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --service-instance-id si-b58c874912fc42940000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
